intro.h2: Granite done right, by people you will recommend
paragraphs: Top Notch Granite installs granite countertops in Florence and nearby. It is led by Fredrick, or Fred, as some customers call him. He is quick to communicate, comes out to measure, gives you a quote and has a wide variety of stone for you to choose from.

Word of mouth matters here. One customer was recommended to Fredrick, has since recommended him to many other people, and found his pricing very competitive and more reasonable than larger companies. Reviewers describe the crew as very careful installers who finish on time, and Google's review summary calls them good people that do a fantastic job for an affordable price.

items.name: Kitchen countertops, islands and bars
items.blurb: Granite for whole kitchens, from the counters around your sink and range to islands and bar tops cut to fit your layout. One customer's kitchen has cream and gold granite on the perimeter counters, a wood island with rounded corners and an angled breakfast bar.

items.name: Bathroom granite
items.blurb: Granite vanity tops for bathroom remodels. One homeowner used Top Notch for the granite in a bathroom remodel and said they did a great job and finished on time. He would definitely use them again and recommends them for all your granite needs.

items.title: Prompt from the first call
items.text: Promptness is the top theme in Top Notch's Google reviews. Customers say Fredrick was quick to communicate, quick to come out and measure, and quick with a quote.

items.title: Fair, competitive pricing

items.title: Careful installers
items.text: The crew is described as very careful installing and on time. Customers call the finished work beautiful and say they are extremely pleased with their kitchens.

about.h2: About Fredrick and Top Notch Granite
about.text: Top Notch Granite solid countertops is a granite supplier and installer at 93 Jackson Cir in Florence, Mississippi, led by Fredrick, known to some customers as Fred. Customers say he answers quickly, comes out to measure and gives the quote himself. His crew does the installing, and reviewers keep using the same words for them: top notch, careful, on time and exceptional. The company's own Google post says it does granite for kitchens, bathrooms and commercial projects. Its Google profile holds 87 photos and a perfect 5.0 rating from 10 reviews.

image.alt: Cream and gold granite island under a drum chandelier in a customer's kitchen

steps.text: Call (601) 540-0755 Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Customers say he is quick to communicate.

steps.title: Careful installation
steps.text: The crew installs your granite on schedule and with care, so you can start using your new kitchen or bath.

service_area.h2: Granite countertops in Florence and nearby
service_area.text: Top Notch Granite is based at 93 Jackson Cir in Florence, Mississippi. Fredrick comes out to measure at your home, and the crew installs on site, so the work happens where you live. Homeowners in and around Florence can call (601) 540-0755 on weekdays between 8 AM and 5 PM to ask whether their address is in range and to set up a measuring visit.

items.q: Do you come out to measure?
items.a: Yes. Fredrick comes out to your home to measure, then gives you a quote. Customers say he was quick to communicate and quick to get out to the house, which helps keep your kitchen or bathroom project moving. Call (601) 540-0755 on a weekday to set up a visit.

items.q: Do you do bathroom countertops too?
items.a: Yes. Top Notch has supplied and installed granite for bathroom remodels as well as kitchens. One customer used them for the granite in a bathroom remodel and said they did a great job and on time, and would recommend them for all your granite needs.

items.q: How much choice do I have?
items.a: Customers say Top Notch has a wide variety to choose from. Past jobs include warm cream and gold speckled granite and dark granite with white veining, so you can find a stone that suits painted, stained or two-tone cabinets in your home.

items.q: Are you more expensive than the big companies?
items.a: Customers say no. One reviewer found the pricing very competitive and more reasonable than larger companies, and Google's review summary describes good people doing a fantastic job for an affordable price. Your quote depends on your measurements and the stone you choose.

Top Notch Granite is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends. Call (601) 540-0755 during those hours, or email federick.oberto@gmail.com with photos and rough measurements of your counters so Fredrick has what he needs to help.

final_cta.text: Call Fredrick to set up a measuring visit and get your quote.
